quests.title: The Secret Ingredient
quests.summary: Find out what Norwich's best cook puts in the gravy, and report back to Cambridge.

steps.line: The gravy? A spoon of the strong tea, love. Don't tell anyone, they'll all be at it.

steps.text: Take the secret back to Cambridge.
steps.line: Tea! In gravy! That's outrageous and it makes complete sense. Take this for your honesty.

start.ask: Hello, I've been trying to copy a gravy from Norwich for a year. Would you ask the cook what's in it? Do it casually.
start.accept: Casually. Right. Don't mention my name.

quests.title: Three Houses and a Rumour
quests.summary: Pass a rumour from Norwich to Cambridge, hear what Cambridge makes of it, and report back.

steps.line: That old tale? It's true, but half of it, and the dull half. Ask over in Cambridge, they'll tell you the rest.
Oh, that. It was a swan, in the end. It's always a swan. Tell them it was a swan.
A swan! I said it was a swan! Nobody listens. Here, you listened.

start.ask: Hello, I've heard something about Cambridge, but I'd like it confirmed. Would you ask round? Pass it on gently.
start.accept: Lovely. Whatever they say, I knew it already.
